title: 第82章 顺便，当个采花贼！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 皇宫，御书房。　　“什么？你们说什么？唐逸那兔崽子会炼体术？”　　炎文帝原本已经睡眼惺忪，现在听完狄苍的汇报，整个人就像是被踩了尾巴一样，一蹦三尺高！　　“狄卿，大晚上的你莫要消遣朕，炼体术，那可是传说中的东西，唐逸那兔崽子怎么可能会？”　　炎文帝来回踱步，难以置信。　　作为皇帝，他很清楚炼体术意味着什么，某种意义上来说，这就是一支军队的魂。　　根据史书记载，炼体术练出来的军队，军纪严明，战无不胜。　　而能搞出炼体术的，多数都是举世闻名的大将，唐逸那兔崽子够这个资格？　　“陛下，是真的，唐小子真会炼体术。”狄苍昂首挺胸保证道。　　“陛下，臣可以作证。”秦国公秦牧重重拱手。　　“臣也可以证明，臣还可以证明秦牧当时说那要是炼体术，他就把练武场的桌子吃了。陛下，他到现在都还没吃。”　　程茂站了出来，连同秦牧的刁状都告了。　　闻言，秦牧狠狠瞪着程茂，混蛋，唐逸那小子都忘记了，你追究什么？　　不爽？出宫打一架啊！　　炎文帝见到三人说得信誓旦旦，终于是信了，脸上充满震惊和震撼。　　他在原地转了一圈，然后用力地挥了挥拳头，充满魔性的笑声便在大殿上传开：“好，好，哈哈哈……不愧是朕看重的人。”　　“如今我大炎的军队犹如一盘散沙，最需要的就是炼体术。”　　“狄卿，你们这大半夜的进宫，不会就只告诉朕这个消息，说吧，你们想干嘛？”　　狄苍就等炎文帝这句话，当即拱手道：“练将，臣想让唐逸，用他的炼体术，帮助大炎训练出一批将领出来。”　　“练兵，得先练将！”　　炎文帝沉吟了一下，摇了摇头道：“哪怕有炼体术，但军中那些骄兵悍将，不会听从唐逸的命令的。”　　“这小子，现在还不过是个小小的锦衣卫。”　　“没有威望，没有权势，他怎能控制那些骄兵悍将？”　　狄苍想到唐逸当时脸上的自信，笑着说道：“唐逸说了，他能行，因此老臣也相信，他能行。”　　“再者，老臣，秦牧，程茂我们一群老家伙都得经唐逸训练，谁敢不服？老子……不，老臣打断他的腿。”　　炎文帝听到狄苍的话，彻底放心下来了。　　狄苍这些老帅都得参加唐逸的训练，那些将领谁敢有意见？　　刚好，趁这个机会，将京都军队的将领调换一下，想到这些炎文帝看向狄苍道：“既然如此，那便传朕旨意吧！”　　“除了北境，东境将领不动，西境，南境四品以上将领，轮番回京受训。”　　“受训地点就选在宫墙外的校场，按照唐逸的想法，北仓校场外的所有区域，改名大炎军校。”　　“校长……唐逸！”　　说到这里皇帝双眸微凝，校长？怎么感觉这个称呼有点怪怪的？　　而且让一个没上过战场的家伙任校长，肯定不能服众，不知道那些骄兵悍将回来，会闹成什么样呢。　　要是唐逸那小子扛不住，那朕这脸可就丢大了。　　“陛下圣明！”狄苍三人齐声说道。　　炎文帝嘴角微微抽了抽，好吧，朕都圣明了，那就看看唐逸那小子能玩出什么花样来吧！　　敢让朕在群臣面前丢人，看朕怎么收拾他。　　……　　南城，农家小院。　　穿着斗篷的黑衣男子坐在院中，一手持碗，一手持筷，正等着女孩的晚餐。　　很快，穿着素群的女孩便端着一大锅菜，从厨房跑了出来。　　“啊啊，好烫好烫，主上快帮忙……”　　因为太烫，女孩被烫的俏脸通红，抓着锅耳的手指不断地变换。　　男人却没有理她，反而气哼哼地将脑袋偏到了一边。　　去买个菜打探个小希，居然足足走了半天的时间，害得他差点给饿死了，还想要他帮忙？　　哼，做梦！　　“哎呀，主上，你别这么小气嘛！”　　女孩将锅重重放在嘴上，然后赶紧跑到水井边。　　将双手插入了水桶中，那冰凉的感觉让她舒服得忍不住长吟一声。　　她瞪了男人一眼，道：“赵铮，不就是给你做饭晚了一点吗？有必要？”　　赵峥竖起两根手指，道：“足足晚了两个时辰，是晚一点吗……”　　话没说完，他抬起筷子的手陡然僵硬，脑袋机械地转过头看向女孩，咬牙切齿道：“肉呢？我的肉呢？不是说好今晚吃肉的吗？你又给我吃白菜炖萝卜？”　　“青衣，信不信我打死你！”　　白天，这丫头可是骗了他所有的财产去买肉的。　　结果出去半天，就买回来几根胡萝卜和白菜，清汤寡水一点味都没有，这怎么吃？　　“呃，主上，我这不是回来晚了么，没肉卖了。”　　青衣眼睛骨碌转，转移话题：“主上，我已经打探到消息了，皇帝要亲自参加沈园诗会，我们可以在沈园诗会亲手将他宰了。”　　“将皇帝给宰了，到时候咱们就可以揭竿而起，光明正大地造反复国了。”　　“到时候主上就不是什么遥远的前朝太子，而是皇帝。”　　然而，面对女孩的怂恿，青年摘下兜帽，露出那张俊逸无比的脸，冲着女孩伸出手咬牙切齿道：“本公子的金子呢？本公子给你那么一大块金子呢？你还我。”　　女孩吐了吐舌头，道：“哎呀，主上，金子什么的不重要，等咱们宰了皇帝，就什么都有了。”　　赵铮看到女孩脑袋上漂亮的蝴蝶金簪，抬头无语问苍天。　　妈的，这到底谁才是主人啊，这天底下竟然有连主人的救命钱都坑的丫鬟吗？　　“告诉咱们的人，炎文帝我们不动手。”　　赵铮夹了一块白菜，生无可恋地丢进嘴中，道：“给我在暗榜发悬赏，我出钱十万两……买炎文帝的脑袋。”　　“啥？”　　女孩猛地跳了起来，连水桶都掀翻了：“主上，我们哪里来的钱？”　　赵铮深吸一口气，道：“京都为富不仁者多了去了，今晚，主上我要去替天行道，取大炎商贾世家之钱财，助我复国。”　　女孩当即抱着脑袋蹲在地上，哭丧着脸：“主上，你堕落了。”　　“我知道，你还想顺便当个采花贼！”　　“可怜啊，人家的太子妃享尽富贵荣华，我家的太子妃却只能遍地开花。”
content_en: Imperial Palace, Imperial Study Room."What? What are you talking about? That bastard Tang Yi knows how to practice physical training?" Emperor Yan Wen was already sleepy-eyed, but now after listening to Di Cang's report, he jumped three feet high as if his tail had been stepped on!"Di Qing, don't entertain me this late at night. Body refining is a legendary thing. How could that bastard Tang Yi do it?" Emperor Yan Wen paced back and forth in disbelief.As the emperor, he knew very well what physical refining meant. In a sense, it was the soul of an army.According to historical records, armies trained through physical training have strict military discipline and are invincible.And most of the people who can master the body refining technique are world-famous generals. Is that bastard Tang Yi qualified for this?"Your Majesty, it's true, Mr. Tang is really good at physical training." Di Cang assured with his head held high."Your Majesty, I can testify." Qin Mu, Duke of Qin, handed over his hands heavily."I can also prove it. I can also prove that Qin Mu said at that time that if it was a physical training technique, he would eat it off the table in the martial arts training ground. Your Majesty, he hasn't eaten it yet." Cheng Mao stood up and complained about Qin Mu's trickery.Hearing this, Qin Mu glared at Cheng Mao fiercely, "bastard, that guy Tang Yi has forgotten, what are you pursuing?"Not happy?Come out of the palace and have a fight!When Emperor Yanwen saw the three people swearing so confidently, he finally believed them, his face full of shock and shock.He turned around in a circle, then waved his fist vigorously, and the devilish laughter spread in the hall: "Okay, okay, hahaha... You are worthy of being someone I value." "Now my Dayan's army is like a pile of loose sand, and what it needs most is physical training." "Di Qing, you guys are doing this in the middle of the night.When you enter the palace, you won't just tell me this news.Tell me, what do you want to do?" Di Cang waited for Emperor Yanwen's words and immediately said, "Training generals, I want Tang Yi to use his body training skills to help Dayan train a group of generals." "Training troops, you have to train generals first!", shook his head and said: "Even if he has physical refining skills, those arrogant and powerful generals in the army will not obey Tang Yi's orders." "This boy is just a little Jinyi guard now." "Without prestige and power, how can he control those arrogant and powerful generals?" Di Cang thought of the pride on Tang Yi's face at that time.Xin, smiled and said: "Tang Yi said that he can do it, so the old minister also believes that he can do it." "Besides, the old minister, Qin Mu, Cheng Mao and we old guys have to be trained by Tang Yi, who dares to disobey? I... No, the old minister broke his legs." Emperor Yanwen was completely relieved after hearing Di Cang's words.Old commanders like Di Cang had to participate in Tang Yi's training. Who among those generals would dare to have an opinion?It just so happened that I took this opportunity to change the generals of the Kyoto army. Thinking of these, Emperor Yanwen looked at Di Cang and said, "In that case, then pass on my will!" "Except for the northern border, the generals of the eastern border will not move, and the generals of fourth grade and above in the western and southern borders will not move.Return to Beijing for training.""The training location will be at the school grounds outside the palace wall.According to Tang Yi's idea, all areas outside Beicang Campus will be renamed Dayan Military Academy." "Principal...Tang Yi!" At this point, the emperor's eyes narrowed slightly, principal?Why do you feel this title is a bit weird?And letting a guy who has never been on the battlefield serve as the principal will definitely not convince the public. I wonder what kind of trouble will happen when those proud soldiers come back.If that boy Tang Yi can't bear it, I will be embarrassed."Your Majesty, Your Majesty!" Di Cang and the three of them said in unison.The corner of Emperor Yanwen's mouth twitched slightly, okay, I've already understood it, let's see what tricks that kid Tang Yi can do!If you dare to embarrass me in front of the officials, let’s see how I deal with him.…… Nancheng, a small farmhouse.The man in black wearing a cloak was sitting in the courtyard, holding a bowl in one hand and chopsticks in the other, waiting for the girl's dinner.Soon, the girl in plain clothes ran out of the kitchen carrying a large pot of food."Ah, it's so hot, my lord, please help me..." Because it was too hot, the girl's pretty face turned red from the heat, and her fingers that were holding the pot ears kept changing.The man ignored her and turned his head to one side angrily.I went to buy some groceries to check on Xiao hope, but I actually walked for half a day and almost starved to death. You still want his help?Humph, dreaming!"Oh, my lord, don't be so stingy!" The girl placed the pot heavily on her mouth and hurried to the well.She inserted her hands into the bucket, and the cold feeling made her so comfortable that she couldn't help but groan.She glared at the man and said: "Zhao Zheng, isn't it just a little late to cook for you? Is it necessary?" Zhao Zheng raised two fingers and said: "It's a full two hours late, is it a little late..." Before he could finish speaking, his hand that raised the chopsticks suddenly stiffened, and his headMechanically, he turned his head to look at the girl and said through gritted teeth: "Where's the meat? Where's my meat? Didn't we agree to eat meat tonight? Are you giving me cabbage stewed with radish again?" "Qing Yi, believe it or not, I'll beat you to death!" During the day, this girl had defrauded him of all his property to buy meat.As a result, I went out for a long time and bought a few carrots and cabbage. The clear soup was watery and tasteless at all. How to eat it?"Uh, Your Majesty, am I not coming back late? I have no meat to sell." Qing Yi rolled his eyes and changed the subject: "Your Majesty, I have already found out the news. The Emperor is going to attend the Shen Yuan Poetry Recital in person. We can do it in Shen Yuan."Yuan Shihui will kill him with his own hands." "Kill the emperor, and then we can rise up and re-establish the kingdom in an upright manner." "Then the Lord will no longer be a distant prince, but the emperor."However, in the face of the girl's instigation, the young man took off his hood, revealed his extremely handsome face, stretched out his hand towards the girl and said with gritted teeth: "Where is my gold?Why did I give you such a large piece of gold?You give it back to me.The girl stuck out her tongue and said, "Oh, my lord, gold is not important. When we kill the emperor, we will have everything."Zhao Zheng saw the beautiful butterfly gold hairpin on the girl's head and raised his head to ask the sky silently.Damn it, who is the master here? Is there any maid in this world who can even cheat the master’s life-saving money?"Tell our people, Yan Wen
